name: Band Reverse-Grip Pulldown
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead, kneel facing the anchor, and grasp the ends shoulder-width apart with an underhand palms-facing-you grip.
Sit tall with your arms extended overhead, core braced, and chest lifted.
Pull your elbows smoothly down close to your ribs to bring your hands toward your upper chest.
Extend your arms slowly back overhead under steady tension.
tips: Keep your forearms lined up with the band's pull throughout each repetition.
Draw your elbows down toward your hips so your lats do the primary work.
